text: try again on 20261103-201526-t4qv with the root cause named: the published decisions page reads steward work items from the athena/records branch, but the approve-work and reject-work decisions are recorded under records/work-decisions/ on main (for example records/work-decisions/2026-10/20261030-081746-a1he.json, which settles 20261017-204324-jtd2) and that directory is absent from athena/records. So the page never sees any decision and lists every proposal as waiting. Fix the page to read the decisions from where they are recorded (or copy them to the records branch with the work items), so decided proposals drop off. Acceptance: a test that builds the page from a records tree where the work item is on the records branch and its decision is on main, and the proposal is not listed.
